settings.remove_action_order: The skills after it move up one place in the composer.

settings.drop_question: {name} has changes not saved. Drop them?

settings.back_tip: Back to where you came from
settings.child_back_tip: Back to the item, adding nothing
settings.child_remove_tip: Take it off this list; it saves at once
settings.cancel_tip: Stop editing; what is saved stays
settings.kind_last: The only kind stays: every session has one.
settings.default_tip: Suggest it first when a session is created or imported
settings.is_default: Already the default: suggested first when a session is created or imported
settings.kind_is_default: Yes: suggested first when a session is created or imported
settings.default_chat_tip: Answer questions with it, and the skills and session kinds that pick no model; saved at once
settings.default_translation_tip: Translate with it in sessions whose kind picks no translation model; saved at once. Until one is set, the chat default translates
settings.default_review_tip: Review answers with it while review is on in General; saved at once, review stays on or off
settings.default_transcription_tip: Transcribe with it in sessions whose kind picks no transcription model; saved at once
settings.languages_note: The spoken languages a session can start in; the default is chosen first. The default transcription model is set on the Models table.
prompts.note: The instructions the models get with every answer. The reviewer's is used while answers are reviewed, turned on under General.
prompts.rules_note: Every answer, in every session, follows these rules unless the question asks otherwise.
prompts.reviewer_note: What the reviewer is asked after each draft, to rewrite it before you see it.
settings.delete_in_use: The default for chat or transcription: make another model that default first.
settings.models_note: Register each model once — chat or transcription — with its provider, and make it a default from the bar. Skills, session kinds and the reviewer may pick another; here a model shows what it is the default for and what else uses it.
settings.no_chat_note: eco records and transcribes without one. Answers, skills and translation need a chat model: register one under Models and make it the default for chat there.
settings.kind_help: The default kind is suggested when you create or import a session. Open a kind to rename it, make it the default or give it its own models; without them, it uses the defaults set on the Models table.
answers.remove_slot_kinds: Sessions of {kinds} no longer start with it on.
answers.context_note: Every answer, in every session, is sent with these files.
answers.slot_note: A session sends these files with its answers while the slot is on there: from the start in the kinds chosen here, or once turned on under CONTEXT in the session.
provider.list_tip: Ask the provider which models it offers
provider.keys_env_hint: Variables named ECO_<NAME> and the provider keys eco knows are listed, never their values. A new variable shows after eco restart: eco reads its environment when it starts.
provider.keys_credential_hint: A new credential eco:<name> shows at once.
provider.credentials_unlisted: The Credential Manager could not be listed: {detail}
provider.omapass_empty: No passwords in omapass yet; add one there first.
provider.omapass_install: Open the page that tells how to install omapass
provider.credential_how: Store the key with eco key set {name} in a terminal, or add the generic credential eco:{name} in the Credential Manager with the key as its password.
audio.you_tip: This audio source is you: your lines show on the right and the model knows they are yours
audio.drop_echoes_tip: A line of yours that repeats what the others just said is their audio leaking into your microphone: it is dropped
audio.echo_cancel_tip: While a session records, what the default output plays is taken out of your microphone
interface.hide_from_share_tip: eco's windows are hidden from whoever watches your shared screen, and from your own screenshots and recordings too: the system cannot tell them apart
interface.tray_tip: An icon in the system tray (the bar's on Omarchy, the notification area on Windows, the menu bar on macOS, where a right click opens the menu): a click opens eco, its menu starts a session, opens the settings or stops eco
interface.notifications_tip: While no eco window is active, the system notifies when transcription stops or comes back, an answer is ready, an error occurs or a newer release is out; an answer is named, never shown
interface.language_tip: The language of eco's windows; automatic follows the system's
general.review_tip: A second model rewrites every answer before you see it, cutting what the transcript, notes and context do not support. Answers take a few seconds longer. Turned on with no reviewer model, it takes the chat default; another is made the default for review on the Models table.
general.show_draft_tip: Also show and keep the draft the reviewer rewrote, to inspect it
general.context_tip: How many characters of transcript and earlier answers a request may carry, about four per token
general.concurrency_tip: How many answers stream at once, across all sessions; the others wait their turn
general.update_check_tip: Once a day eco asks GitHub for the tag of the latest release, sending nothing about you, and the window tells when a newer one is out
general.version_tip: The eco running now and the latest release. UPDATE downloads it, checks its checksum and installs it; on Linux the system asks for your password. A session that records goes on: eco restarts once it ends
general.daemon_tip: The eco process that records, transcribes and answers. RESTART stops it and starts it again, and the window reconnects; while a session records it asks first
general.uninstall_tip: Remove eco from this computer. It asks first, and your sessions, people, config and models stay unless you choose to delete them
update.error_tip: Could not ask for the latest release: {error}
update.update_tip: Download eco {version}, check it and install it
update.check_now_tip: Ask GitHub for the latest release now
update.restart_tip: Stop the eco daemon and start it again
update.restart_question: A session is recording. Restarting eco now stops its recording.
update.stage.waiting: eco {version} installed · restarts when the session ends
uninstall.tip: Ask to remove eco from this computer
uninstall.title: Uninstall eco
uninstall.question_keep: eco, its window, its shortcuts and its service are removed. Your sessions, people, config and models stay on this computer.
uninstall.question_everything: eco, its window, its shortcuts and its service are removed, and so are your sessions, people, config and models.
update.notice_tip: A newer eco is out: open its release notes

pending.title: approve this change

error.models.credential_missing: no key in the Windows Credential Manager under eco:{credential}; run eco key set {credential}
audio.devices_empty: No audio device found. REFRESH DEVICES reads them again.
audio.sources_empty: No audio source yet: in a device's HEARD AS, choose New source…
audio.new_source_note: Name the audio source heard through {device}. The device is taken from the source that had it; it saves at once.
